alternative_explanations: The fixed Haar basis may merely reparameterize an ordinary linear predictor and add no causal value.

confounds: Only two locally visible test files are available, so this is screening rather than independent hidden-holdout evidence.
H96 is evaluator-created recursive depth extrapolation beyond fit horizon 32, not a naturally longer response sequence.
falsification_criteria: Discard if main fails in any K cell at H32 or H96 to improve NRMSE over each causal ablation by at least 0.1325268421060828.
